name: The bookmark editor and the details page's rows, as admin on Long Test Movie: the details page's 'My bookmarks (n)' section with its two page links, See all and My Clips (the capabilities offer My Bookmarks and My Clips), rows by their display title (the name, else the note's first line, else 'Bookmark at 0:15') with a name's note as a second line and 'Name it' on unnamed rows; Name it opens the editor with Name focused (fields Name, Start, End, Note as a textarea), Enter saves the name; the delete confirmation's 'Also delete its clip' unticked with the hint that the clip stays in My Clips (since My Clips lists kept clips; ticked with a next-update hint in 1.1.0), the clip kept when unticked (a tombstone) and deleted with the bookmark when ticked, and, when the confirmation opened without the box (no clip file yet), a clip that finished while it was open kept as well (the default without the box follows the box's); the player's range flow opens the editor with Name focused and Save & make clip names the clip file after the name. Run by bookmarks-rows-probe.mjs, which checks the clip folder afterwards. Every name and note starts with 'rows-probe'; the bookmarks it makes are deleted at the end (and at the start of the next run).

steps.name: sign in as admin
the Bookmarks script ran
find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: the capabilities offer My Bookmarks and My Clips
steps.assert: ((c) => !!c.Pages && c.Pages.Bookmarks === true && c.Pages.Clips === true && c.MaxNameLength === 100 && c.MaxNoteLength === 500)(await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Capabilities')))

steps.name: the movie's rows-probe bookmarks of an earlier run deleted, with their clips
steps.script: const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); let n = 0; for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (/^rows-probe/.test(b.Name || '') || /^rows-probe/.test(b.Note || '')) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); n++; } } return n;

steps.name: three bookmarks through the API: unnamed without a note at 0:15, named with a two-line note at 0:20, a range 0:30-0:34 with a note
steps.script: const post = (body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ ItemId: __vars.movieId }, body)), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); const a = await post({ StartTicks: 150000000 }); const b = await post({ StartTicks: 200000000, Name: 'rows-probe named', Note: 'rows-probe first line\nsecond line' }); const c = await post({ StartTicks: 300000000, EndTicks: 340000000, Note: 'rows-probe clip kept' }); return { a: a.Id, b: b.Id, c: c.Id };

steps.name: the unnamed one's id
the range's id
a Fast clip of the range, through the API
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.ids.c + '/Clip'), data: JSON.stringify({ Mode: 'Fast' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); for (let i = 0; i < 180; i++) { const b = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.ids.c)); if (b.Clip && b.Clip.Status === 'Completed' && b.Clip.FileName) return b.Clip.FileName; if (b.Clip && b.Clip.Status === 'Failed') throw new Error('the clip failed: ' + b.Clip.Error); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } throw new Error('the clip did not complete');

steps.name: open the details page
the section is 'My bookmarks (n)' with the rows' display titles
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); if (!s || s.classList.contains('hide') || !/^My bookmarks \(\d+\)$/.test(s.querySelector('h2').textContent)) return false; const row = (id) => s.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"]'); const a = row(__vars.ids.a), b = row(__vars.ids.b), c = row(__vars.ids.c); if (!a || !b || !c || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-clip-ready')) return false; return { a: [a.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent, !!a.querySelector('.jfbm-name-it'), !!a.querySelector('.jfbm-row-subtitle')], b: [b.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent, !!b.querySelector('.jfbm-name-it'), b.querySelector('.jfbm-row-subtitle').textContent], c: [c.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent, !!c.querySelector('.jfbm-name-it')] }; })()

steps.name: unnamed without a note: 'Bookmark at 0:15' with Name it; named: its name, its note's first line under it, no Name it; the range: its note, with Name it
steps.assert: JSON.stringify(__vars.rows) === JSON.stringify({ a: ['Bookmark at 0:15', true, false], b: ['rows-probe named', false, 'rows-probe first line'], c: ['rows-probe clip kept', true] })

steps.name: the section's page links: See all (My Bookmarks filtered to this video), then My Clips
steps.assert: (() => { const l = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section .jfbm-section-links'); const links = l ? Array.from(l.querySelectorAll('a[data-jfbm-link]')) : []; return !!l && !l.classList.contains('hide') && links.length === 2 && links[0].getAttribute('data-jfbm-link') === 'bookmarks' && links[0].textContent.trim() === 'See all' && links[0].getAttribute('href') === '#/jfbm-bookmarks?item=' + __vars.movieId && links[1].getAttribute('data-jfbm-link') === 'clips' && links[1].textContent.trim() === 'My Clips' && links[1].getAttribute('href') === '#/jfbm-clips'; })()

steps.name: no badge on these rows (attached and available)
Name it on the unnamed bookmark
the editor: Name, Start, End, Note (a textarea), with the focus in the empty Name field
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Edit bookmark') return false; const labels = [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-field > label')].map(l => l.textContent).join(','); const name = p.querySelector('input[maxlength="100"]'); return labels === 'Name,Start,End,Note' && document.activeElement === name && name.value === '' && p.querySelector('textarea[maxlength="500"]').value === '' && p.querySelectorAll('input[type=text]')[1].value === '0:15.0'; })()

Delete on the range with the clip

steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Delete bookmark?') return false; const box = p.querySelector('.jfbm-checkbox input'); return p.querySelector('p').textContent === '"rows-probe clip kept" at 0:30 will be deleted.' && p.querySelector('.jfbm-checkbox span').textContent === 'Also delete its clip (' + __vars.keptClip + ')' && box.checked === false && ((hint) => !hint.classList.contains('hide') && hint.getClientRects().length > 0 && hint.textContent === 'The clip stays in My Clips.')(p.querySelector('.jfbm-delete-hint')); })()

steps.name: tick it
ticked: the hint goes
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return p.querySelector('.jfbm-checkbox input').checked === true && p.querySelector('.jfbm-delete-hint').classList.contains('hide'); })()

steps.name: untick it
unticked: the hint back
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const hint = p.querySelector('.jfbm-delete-hint'); return p.querySelector('.jfbm-checkbox input').checked === false && !hint.classList.contains('hide') && hint.getClientRects().length > 0 && hint.textContent === 'The clip stays in My Clips.'; })()

steps.name: Delete
deleted, the row gone
unticked, the clip was kept: the bookmark is 404, its clip file still downloads, then DELETE /Bookmarks/{id}/Clip removes it (204)
steps.script: const status = async (method, p, q) => (await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(p, q), { method, headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' } })).status; const bookmark = await status('GET', 'Bookmarks/' + __vars.ids.c); const file = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.ids.c + '/Clip/File', { ApiKey: ApiClient.accessToken(), download: 'false' })); const bytes = file.ok ? (await file.arrayBuffer()).byteLength : 0; const removed = await status('DELETE', 'Bookmarks/' + __vars.ids.c + '/Clip'); const again = await status('DELETE', 'Bookmarks/' + __vars.ids.c + '/Clip'); if (bookmark !== 404 || file.status !== 200 || bytes <= 0 || removed !== 204 || again !== 404) throw new Error(JSON.stringify({ bookmark, file: file.status, bytes, removed, again })); return { bookmark, file: file.status, bytes, removed, again };

steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'New bookmark') return false; const v = [...p.querySelectorAll('input[type=text]')].map(i => i.value); return v[0] === '' && document.activeElement === p.querySelector('input[maxlength="100"]') && /^\d+:\d\d\.\d$/.test(v[1]) && /^\d+:\d\d\.\d$/.test(v[2]) && /^Range length /.test(p.querySelector('.jfbm-hint').textContent); })()

Save & make clip
steps.script: [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel .jfbm-actions button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Save & make clip').click(); return true;

steps.name: the editor closes and the clip is being made
steps.waitFor: !document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop') && [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].some(t => t.textContent === 'Making the clip. You can keep watching.')

steps.name: the named clip completes, its file named after the name
steps.script: for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) { const b = (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))).find(x => x.Name === 'rows-probe Bank job'); if (b && b.Clip && b.Clip.Status === 'Completed' && b.Clip.FileName) { if (!/^Long Test Movie \(\d{4}\) - rows-probe Bank job \[\d\d\.\d\d\.\d\d-\d\d\.\d\d\.\d\d\]\.(mp4|mkv)$/.test(b.Clip.FileName)) throw new Error('unexpected file name ' + b.Clip.FileName); return { id: b.Id, fileName: b.Clip.FileName, fileSize: b.Clip.FileSize, note: b.Note || null }; } if (b && b.Clip && b.Clip.Status === 'Failed') throw new Error('the clip failed: ' + b.Clip.Error); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } throw new Error('the named clip did not complete');
